# Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` first. This is an unofficial fan project, so keep legal, brand, platform, and image-use constraints conservative.

- Do not add Former members to seeds, UI, filters, tests, or notification targets.
- Keep Gangzi in the `gamja` category as `catalogRole=representative`.
- Keep Stellive official channels in the `official`/`기타` category as `catalogRole=official_channel`.
- Official YouTube supports upload notifications only; never generate official YouTube live scheduled/started/ended notifications.
- Do not add secrets, profile image binaries, official logos, fan art, screenshots, or copied CDN assets.
- Use official APIs or mock adapters with TODO/verify_required markers.
- Route every push decision through preference resolution.
- Treat `realtime_best_effort` as best-effort delivery priority, not as a permission override.
